title: The robot that can do your entire job better than you

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Look at this robot — it’s replacing jobs faster than you can say “AI.”

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This tech is already in factories and offices worldwide.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: It’s a humanoid robot named Digit, built by Agility Robotics.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: It can walk, lift, and perform tasks with precision and speed.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: It’s hitting warehouses and delivery routes — your job is next.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The future isn’t just coming — it’s already here.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Will you be ready when the robot takes your job?

caption_text: The robot that can do your entire job better than you
